notes:
Patch 0.1.22

Script update for installs already on 0.1.21. Same safe Apply as 0.1.21: Managed scripts only. It does not replace world data.

Hotbar
- The item in the selected hotbar slot shows in the slot. It had been drawn under the bottom of the screen, so the slot looked like an empty yellow square.

Join
- Joining a hosted game no longer leaves you under the island. Terrain streams, and villagers can see you.

Strikes
- A strike tells you the count and the reason. The notice has a Dispute this button. It opens the Discord bug-reports channel.

Sun
- Looking straight at the sun blinds the view. The glare clears as soon as you look away.

Menu
- Patch notes sit nearer the bottom of the online page. Back has a little more space than the other buttons. Your current name is no longer covered by the rename box.
